text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her defeat in the Kikuka Sho. Admire Vega 
blamed herself, believing it happened 
because she forgot her mission and focused 
only on herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her condition, Trainer considers 
the Spring Senior Triple Crown route for 
next time, but decides she needs a long 
rest and sets her next race to the 
"Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Admire Vega's inner turmoil was 
so severe that she even brushed away the 
hand Narita Top Road reached out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Casting aside her love for racing, and 
severing ties with her rivals, Admire Vega 
steadfastly chose solitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, she could never be true to her 
sister. Admire Vega ran off alone into the 
darkness...
